scheme_name: Marriage Assistance For Legally Married Transgender Couples
other_conditions: Applicant must possess a Transgender Identity card
One of the partners must belong to the Transgender community
Couple must have undergone Sex Reassignment Surgery (SRS)
Financial assistance must be applied for after 6 months from the date of marriage and within 1 year
If already received assistance, not eligible for further aid after a second marriage following divorce
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹30,000 to legally married transgender couples who have undergone Sex Reassignment Surgery (SRS).
